title: A kb_feedback call is captured as a lookup tool, so the digest counts tool issues under kb_feedback and a feedback-only prompt becomes a lookup entry
goal: ql_distill.entry_of leaves kb_feedback out of an entry's lookup tools, so a tool_issue counts only under the tools the lookup used (ql_report.feedback_lines), and a prompt whose only kb call is kb_feedback makes no lookup entry.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import ql_distill; rs = [{'id': 'r1', 'ts': '2026-10-14T08:00:00Z', 'surface': 'mcp', 'tool': 'kb_pack', 'verdict': 'none'}, {'id': 'r2', 'ts': '2026-10-14T08:00:05Z', 'surface': 'mcp', 'tool': 'kb_feedback'}]; e = ql_distill.entry_of(rs, None); print(e and e[0].get('tools')); sys.exit(1 if e and 'kb_feedback' in (e[0].get('tools') or []) else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import ql_distill
# a prompt whose only kb call is kb_feedback makes no lookup entry
rs = [{'id': 'r2', 'ts': '2026-10-14T08:00:05Z', 'surface': 'mcp', 'tool': 'kb_feedback', 'question': 'how does x work'}]
e = ql_distill.entry_of(rs, None)
entry = e[0] if e else None
print('entry of a feedback-only prompt:', entry)
sys.exit(0 if not entry or not entry.get('tools') else 1)
